groups.name: ecommerce.inventory-reservation
groups.description: Inventory reservation lifecycle and scheduler configuration.

properties.name: ecommerce.inventory-reservation.enabled
properties.description: Controls whether the inventory reservation expiration scheduler is enabled.

properties.name: ecommerce.inventory-reservation.ttl
properties.description: Time-to-live ISO-8601 duration for pending inventory reservations before expiration.

properties.name: ecommerce.inventory-reservation.expiration-scheduler-delay-ms
properties.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between reservation expiration execution sweeps.

properties.name: ecommerce.inventory-reservation.expiration-scheduler-initial-delay-ms
properties.description: Initial delay in milliseconds before starting reservation expiration runs.
